_about: Captured on 2026-10-03 from a SCRATCH COPY of examples/invoice-app (not the committed fixture) after the data-stores core pass: ErpClient gains getStatus (request with method GET), file (POST) and sync(id, verb) (method not a literal), all through a private request(); finalizeInvoice calls the three after publishing. GET /api/journey?entry=invoice-app::flow::billing-cycle trimmed like map-billing-cycle-stores.json. The ERP row is a store (erp) with three external markers: op reads, op writes, and no op (the method was not recorded). The committed fixture is unchanged because calling the ERP would add a sixth system to the pinned billing-cycle journey.
